set.body:
Owns distribution-method-matrix and multiscale-density-and-comparison. Current Distribution supplies cosine, Pearson, Fisher z and several native distances; Transport supplies sliced W1 and Sinkhorn. Spearman, extended Jaccard and the reference dcov route are not established by those implementations.

Implementation/acceptance:
1. Freeze a dispatch table for default vectors, density objects and the actual multiscale subset: pearson, spearman, fisherz, cosine, l1, jaccard, dcov, emd. Record each output's direction/range and representation. The pinned l1 result is 1 - total variation, not raw L1; dcov calls energy::dcor (distance correlation), not distance covariance; jaccard uses proxy eJaccard. Pin ties, Fisher endpoints, constant/zero/one-cell/empty inputs, common valid cells, unequal lengths and density geometry rather than inventing shared-grid intersection behavior.
2. Establish native method instances under the interfaces they satisfy, named scale transformations, explicit unsupported dispatch and direct-versus-lift agreement. Never call a similarity a Metric or silently normalize Signed values into Mass.
3. Pin scale order/labels, duplicate and unmatched sigmas, mean/none aggregation, missing scale failures and denominators. Reference intersection/NA-dropping is evidence to retain, not permission to drop native results. Supplied-map checks can start before KDE; whole-ticket closure waits for eyesim-kde's non-symmetric density/scale evidence.
4. Preserve the 2026-09-18 exact-EMD decision: measure eyesim exact values next to independently justified sliced W1 and Sinkhorn as intentional divergences. Do not add an LP/network-simplex solver or relabel approximations as exact EMD. Multiscale EMD is unavailable at the pin. Share this reference evidence with scanpath/repetition without granting them unmeasured equivalence.

Ownership: fixation-pattern overlap/Sinkhorn and MultiMatch are eyesim-scanpath; comparison aggregation over supplied maps is here; KDE generation/point evaluation is eyesim-kde. No advanced memory-budget refactor.
Evidence gate: use the revision and backend locks in tools/r-parity/baseline.json and r-lock.json; new inputs/manifests are per-ticket, never edits to frozen baseline-cases.json. Record actual exported reference calls, independent analytic expectations, named numerical tolerances and exact identities. Normal workflows/tests require no R; R is an offline fixture oracle only. Exercise public JVM/Scala.js routes, typed failures and declared divergences; keep every failed/missing case. A function name or internal unit test is not cross-library conformance. New published laws require killed mutants. Update case evidence and PARITY.md only after measurement. See docs/TRACKER_REVIEW_2026-09-19.md for shared ownership and closure ordering.
set.title: Complete the baseline map-comparison method matrix
